UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 - Direct PDF Download Link, Cut Off & Result Date

The UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 is officially out. The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) released the revised (final) answer key for the Revenue Lekhpal Mains Examination on its official website, upsssc.gov.in, on 1 July 2026. This revised key comes after the commission examined all objections raised by candidates against the earlier provisional answer key, making it the basis on which the final result and merit list will be prepared. Candidates who appeared for the UP Lekhpal Mains Exam on 21 May 2026 can now download the set-wise PDF, match their responses, and calculate their expected score using the official marking scheme.

Click Here: UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026

What Is the UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026?

This section explains what the revised answer key is and why it matters more than the earlier provisional key.

The UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 is the updated and near-final set of correct answers released by UPSSSC after reviewing the objections that candidates filed against the provisional answer key. Whenever the commission accepts an objection because a question was found to be wrong, ambiguous, or had more than one correct option the answer for that question is corrected in this revised key. Since it reflects all approved corrections, the revised answer key is considered significantly more reliable than the provisional one for estimating your final score, and it will be the key used to prepare the official UP Lekhpal Result 2026.

UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 - Key Highlights

This table summarizes the most important dates and details related to the UP Lekhpal Mains Exam and its answer key, giving you a quick snapshot before you go through the full details below.

How to Download the UP Lekhpal Revised Answer Key 2026 PDF

This section explains the step-by-step process to download the revised answer key from the official UPSSSC website.

Candidates who took the Lekhpal Mains exam can download the revised answer key directly from the UPSSSC portal. Since the answer key is released set-wise (Set A, B, C, D), make sure you select the same paper series that you received in your exam hall before matching your answers.

  1. Visit the official UPSSSC website at upsssc.gov.in.
  2. Go to the "Latest News" or "Answer Key" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the link that reads "UP Lekhpal Mains Revised Answer Key 2026."
  4. Select your Question Paper Set/Series (A, B, C, or D).
  5. The answer key PDF will open on your screen download and save it.
  6. Compare each answer with the responses you marked in your exam to estimate your expected score.

Candidates are advised to download the PDF only from the official website and keep a saved copy for future reference, since this revised key will be used to determine the final result.

Why Was the Answer Key Revised? Understanding the Objection Process

This section explains why UPSSSC issued a revised key instead of directly declaring results after the provisional key, and what the objection process involved.

After the provisional answer key was released on 22 May 2026, UPSSSC gave candidates a fixed window to challenge any answer they believed was incorrect. This objection facility was active from 26 May 2026 to 1 June 2026. The process worked as follows:

  • Candidates had to log in on the official portal using their registration number and password.
  • They could select the specific question(s) they wanted to challenge and upload supporting proof or reference material for the claimed correct answer.
  • A nominal fee (approximately ₹100 per question) had to be paid online for each objection raised, ensuring only genuine, well-supported challenges were submitted.
  • Only objections submitted with valid proof within the deadline and with successful fee payment were considered valid.

Once the objection window closed, UPSSSC's subject-matter experts reviewed every valid objection. Wherever a challenge was found genuine, the answer was updated and the outcome of this entire exercise is the Revised Answer Key 2026 released on 1 July 2026.

UP Lekhpal Exam 2026: Important Details

This section recaps the exam details that are directly relevant to understanding and using the answer key correctly.

The UP Lekhpal Mains Written Examination was conducted by UPSSSC on 21 May 2026 in a single shift from 10:00 AM to 12:00 Noon across multiple exam centres in Uttar Pradesh. The recruitment drive aims to fill 7,994 Revenue Lekhpal posts. The provisional answer key was released the very next day, on 22 May 2026, followed by the objection window, and finally the revised answer key on 1 July 2026.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the Revised Answer Key

This section explains the exact marking scheme so candidates can calculate their tentative score accurately.

Once you have matched your responses against the revised answer key, you can calculate your probable score using the official UPSSSC marking scheme:

  • Correct Answer: +1 mark
  • Incorrect Answer: −0.25 mark (negative marking of one-fourth mark per wrong answer)
  • Unattempted Question: No mark deducted

Formula to calculate your score:

Final Score = (Total Correct Answers × 1) − (Total Wrong Answers × 0.25)

This section lists the minimum percentage of marks each category must secure to be considered for the final merit list, regardless of overall cut-off trends.

Category Minimum Qualifying Marks

SC / ST 40%

Candidates scoring below their category's minimum qualifying percentage will not be considered for the final merit list, even if their raw score is close to the expected cut off.

UP Lekhpal Expected Cut Off 2026

This section explains the factors that will influence the final cut off and gives an approximate expected range based on exam difficulty and past trends.

The final UP Lekhpal cut off depends on multiple factors: the overall difficulty level of the paper, the total number of candidates who appeared, the number of vacancies (7,994 posts), and category-wise reservation norms. Since the paper has been assessed as easy-to-moderate in difficulty, a slightly higher cut off compared to previous years is expected. Based on these trends, the approximate safe/expected scores are:

Category Expected Safe Score (out of 100)
General 74 - 80
EWS 72 - 77
OBC 70 - 76
SC 60 - 67
ST 57 - 64

Note: These figures are indicative estimates based on exam difficulty and historical trends. The official cut off will be declared by UPSSSC only along with the final result.

The Gujarat Public Service Commission (GPSC) has officially released the Provisional Answer Key 2025-26 for multiple recruitment examinations, including posts of Assistant Professor and Child Development Project Officer (CDPO). Candidates who appeared for these preliminary examinations can now download the answer key PDFs - identified as PAK-94, PAK-91, PAK-85, PAK-83, and PAK-26 - directly from the official GPSC website at gpsc.gujarat.gov.in. This article consolidates everything you need: direct download links, the objection submission process, fee details, important dates, and answers to the most common questions asked by candidates.

Add FJA on  As Preferred Source

What Is the GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26?

This section explains what the provisional answer key is and why it matters for every candidate who appeared in the GPSC 2025-26 examinations.

The GPSC Provisional Answer Key is the official document published by the Gujarat Public Service Commission immediately after a preliminary examination. It lists the correct answer (A, B, C, or D) for every question in the Master Question Paper. The "provisional" nature of the key means it is open for review - candidates who believe any answer is incorrect can formally challenge it within a fixed window. After evaluating all valid objections, GPSC releases a Final Answer Key, which forms the definitive basis for calculating scores and determining merit lists.

The answer keys released under the advertisement numbers below belong to the 2025-26 recruitment cycle and cover subject-specific preliminary examinations under Gujarat Education Service (GES), Class-2 and Women & Child Development Department posts.

GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26: Quick Overview

The table below provides a consolidated snapshot of all five answer keys released, covering the advertisement numbers, PAK codes, and links for download.

PAK Code Post Download Link
PAK-94-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-91-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF

PAK-83-2025-26 Assistant Professor (GES, Class-2) Download PDF
PAK-26-2025-26 Child Development Project Officer (CDPO), Class-2 Download PDF

Note: Always verify subject-specific details and exact examination dates on the official GPSC portal at gpsc.gujarat.gov.in, as GPSC may update information after this publication.

How to Download the GPSC Provisional Answer Key 2025-26 PDF

This section gives you a simple, step-by-step guide to downloading the official provisional answer key from the GPSC website without confusion or delay.

  1. Open your browser and visit the official GPSC website: gpsc.gujarat.gov.in
  2. On the homepage, look for the "Latest News / Events" section or navigate to the "Answer Key" tab.
  3. Find the link corresponding to your advertisement number (e.g., PAK-94-2025-26, PAK-91-2025-26, etc.).
  4. Click the link; the PDF will either open in your browser or begin downloading automatically.
  5. Save the Master Question Paper alongside the answer key for accurate cross-referencing.
  6. Match each question number from the Master Question Paper to the provisional answer provided. Do not use the question numbering from your own booklet set, as sets may differ.

You can also use the direct PDF links provided in the table above to go straight to the relevant document.

Objection Fee

Candidates must pay a non-refundable fee of Rs. 100 per objection. The payment must be made online through the official link provided on the GPSC portal. An objection is considered final only after the fee receipt is generated successfully.

Step-by-Step Objection Process

  1. Visit the official GPSC Online Objection Submission portal link (available on the GPSC website after the objection window opens).
  2. Log in using your credentials (Confirmation Number and Date of Birth).
  3. Identify the Question Number and the option you wish to challenge, always referencing the Master Question Paper, not your own booklet numbering.
  4. Upload supporting documentary evidence (a textbook page, journal article, or other authentic reference). Objections submitted without evidence will be rejected outright.
  5. Ensure the answer you are suggesting matches the response you actually marked on your answer sheet. Mismatched responses are automatically rejected.
  6. Pay the Rs. 100 fee online and save the payment receipt.
  7. Submit the objection before the deadline. Late submissions are not entertained under any circumstances.

Critical Rules to Remember Before Submitting Objections

  • No AI-generated objections: GPSC has explicitly stated that objections backed solely by AI tools (such as ChatGPT or similar) without documentary evidence from a recognized source will not be considered.
  • Calculation-based questions: For mathematical or reasoning questions, the objection must include the full working, methodology, or logical basis.
  • Question numbering must match the Master Paper: Quoting a different question number (from your booklet set) than the one appearing in the Master Question Paper will result in rejection.
  • One fee = one objection: Each challenged question requires a separate payment of Rs. 100.
  • Fees are non-refundable: Even if your objection is accepted and the answer is revised, the fee is not returned.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

Many candidates wonder what the timeline looks like after the provisional answer key is out. This section outlines the standard GPSC process that follows the provisional key release.

  • Objection Window Opens: Candidates can submit challenges through the online objection portal for a fixed period (typically a few days after the key release).
  • Expert Review: GPSC's subject experts evaluate all valid, evidence-backed objections.
  • Final Answer Key Released: After incorporating any corrections, GPSC publishes the Final (Official) Answer Key, which is absolute and binding for result calculation.
  • Preliminary Result Declared: Based on the Final Answer Key, GPSC publishes the list of candidates qualifying for the Main Written Examination.
  • Main Examination: Shortlisted candidates appear for the subject-specific Main Exam, which carries actual merit weightage.
  • Final Selection: The overall merit list is prepared based on Main Exam performance (and interview, if applicable), leading to the final appointment recommendation.

Candidates are advised to regularly check gpsc.gujarat.gov.in for official updates on result dates and subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Important Tips for Candidates: Maximizing Your Score Estimate

While waiting for the final answer key and result, candidates can take these steps to accurately estimate their performance and plan their next move.

  • Download both the Master Question Paper and the Provisional Answer Key PDF together - matching answers using only the Master Paper's question numbers avoids errors caused by different booklet sets.
  • Calculate your attempted score carefully. GPSC preliminary exams typically follow a specific marking scheme - confirm the marks per question and negative marking (if any) from the official notification for your advertisement number.
  • If you identify a genuinely incorrect answer and have strong documentary proof, submit an objection without hesitation. A single corrected answer can shift your score above the cutoff.
  • Avoid circulating or relying on unofficial answer keys shared on social media or Telegram channels, as these may be inaccurate. Always refer to the official GPSC provisional answer key PDF.
  • Begin Main Examination preparation in parallel, especially for subject-specific papers, as the gap between the preliminary result and main exam can be short.

What is the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

The final answer key is the official, verified set of correct answers for the UP Home Guard written examination, published by after carefully reviewing all candidate objections raised against the provisional key. Understanding the difference between a provisional and a final answer key is important for every aspirant.

After the provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026, candidates were given a window from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight) to submit evidence-based objections against any answers they believed were incorrect. The board's subject experts then evaluated all objections received. As per the official notification, objections related to two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts. The final answer key incorporates these corrections, and the UP Home Guard Result 2026 has been computed based on this verified final key. No further objections or challenges are entertained after the release of the final answer key.

Direct Link to Download UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026

How to Download UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026 - Step-by-Step

Downloading the final answer key is a straightforward process. Follow these steps carefully to access your answer key and score card from the official portal without any confusion.

  1. Visit the Official Portal: Go to uppbpb.gov.in or the official website at uppbpb.gov.in.
  2. Click the Answer Key / Result Link: On the homepage, look for the notification titled "UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026" or "Home Guard Written Exam Result 2026."
  3. Enter Login Credentials: Input your Roll Number or Registration Number along with your Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY) and your Question Booklet Number where required.
  4. Click Submit: Press the Submit button to proceed to your personal result and answer key page.
  5. View Your Answer Key and Score: Your set-wise final answer key (Set A, B, C, or D) along with your score card will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and Save: Download the PDF and take a printout for future reference, especially for the upcoming Physical Standard Test (PST) and Document Verification stages.

 

Once you log in and download your scorecard, make sure to verify the following details carefully. Any discrepancy should be reported to immediately through official channels.

  • Candidate's Full Name
  • Father's Name
  • Date of Birth
  • Roll Number / Registration Number
  • Marks Obtained in Written Examination
  • Qualifying Status (Qualified / Not Qualified)
  • Category
  • District Allotted

UP Home Guard Cut-Off Marks 2026 - Category-Wise

The cut-off marks for the UP Home Guard Written Exam 2026 have been released district-wise and category-wise along with the result on 28 June 2026. Here are some important benchmarks every candidate should be aware of.

  • Minimum Qualifying Marks: Every candidate must secure at least 25% marks (25 out of 100) in the written examination to remain in contention. Candidates scoring below 25% are automatically disqualified from the recruitment process, regardless of category.
  • Safe Score (General/OBC): According to experts, a score of 72 marks or above is considered a safe score for General and OBC category candidates.
  • PET Preparation Range: Candidates who have correctly answered approximately 70 to 75 questions are advised to immediately begin preparation for the Physical Efficiency Test (PET/PST).
  • No Negative Marking: There is no negative marking in the UP Home Guard written examination. Every correct answer carries equal marks.

Note: Exact district-wise and category-wise cut-off marks are available on the official website. Candidates are advised to check the official portal for their specific district's cut-off figures.

Validity of the Final Answer Key - What Changed from Provisional to Final

The transition from a provisional to a final answer key is a standard and transparent process that ensures fairness to all candidates. Here is what happened between the provisional and final answer key stages for the UP Home Guard 2026 recruitment.

  • The provisional answer key was released on 7 May 2026.
  • Candidates were allowed to submit evidence-based objections from 7 May to 10 May 2026 (midnight).
  • Subject experts reviewed all submitted objections thoroughly.
  • Objections about two questions were found to be valid across all six examination shifts and were corrected in the final answer key.
  • The corrected final answer key formed the basis for result computation and merit list preparation.
  • No further challenges or objections are accepted after the release of the final answer key.

What Happens Next After the UP Home Guard Final Answer Key 2026?

Clearing the written examination is the first major step in the Home Guard selection process. Candidates who have qualified in the written test and appear on the merit list must prepare for the subsequent stages of the recruitment process.

Next Stages in UP Home Guard Recruitment 2026

  1. Document Verification (DV): Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification. All original certificates, identity proofs, educational documents, and category certificates must be produced at this stage. Any mismatch or missing documents can lead to disqualification.
  2. Physical Standard Test (PST): Candidates must meet the prescribed physical standards regarding height, weight, and chest measurements as per norms.
  3. Physical Efficiency Test (PET): This test evaluates candidates on running, and other physical fitness parameters. Only those who pass the PST proceed to PET.
  4. Final Merit List: The final selection and merit list for all 41,424 Home Guard (Swayamsevak) posts will be prepared based on performance across all stages. The written examination marks form the primary basis for the final merit list.

This section explains how candidates should use the answer key to verify their responses based on their allotted question paper series.

The OMR exam was conducted using four question paper series A, B, C, and D meaning each candidate received one of these four versions of the question booklet. To check answers correctly:

  • Identify the series printed on your OMR sheet/question booklet (A, B, C, or D)
  • Open the relevant annexure (A for Junior Dental Technician, B for Junior Store Clerk)
  • Match each question number with the correct answer option listed under your specific series
  • Avoid cross-checking with a different series, as correct options vary by series for the same question number

Since all four series contain different answer sequences for identical question numbers, candidates must strictly refer to their own series column to get an accurate result.

JKSSB Answer Key Objection Process 2026

This section explains the step-by-step procedure, required documents, and fee for candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the provisional key.

JKSSB allows candidates to formally challenge any answer they believe is incorrect, provided the objection follows the prescribed format and is backed by supporting evidence. The objection window is short, so candidates should act promptly.

Key objection details:

Particular Details
Objection Format Annexure "C" (prescribed proforma)
Submission Mode Offline only
Objection Window 3 working days, starting 25.06.2026
Timing 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Fee ₹200 per question (Demand Draft)
Fee Payable To Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
Refund Condition Refundable only if the objection is found genuine/correct
Submission Centres JKSSB Office, Muthi, Akhnoor Road, Jammu / JKSSB Office, Zamzam Building, Rambagh, Srinagar
Documents Required Hard copies of documentary proof/evidence supporting the claim
Separate Forms Rule One form per question; if multiple questions are entered on one form, only the first will be considered

Steps to raise an objection:

  • Download Annexure "C" (objection proforma) from the official JKSSB notice
  • Fill in candidate details, application number, roll number, exam centre division, and the specific question number with series
  • State the objection clearly and attach hard-copy documentary proof supporting the claim
  • Prepare a demand draft of ₹200 per question in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
  • Submit the completed form, evidence, and demand draft in person at the Jammu or Srinagar JKSSB office within the 3-working-day window
  • Use a separate form for each question being objected to

JKSSB has clearly stated that objections will not be entertained after the stipulated period expires or if submitted through any mode other than offline in person.

What Happens After Objections Are Submitted?

This section explains the review process JKSSB follows once objections are received, and how it affects the final answer key.

Once the objection window closes, JKSSB reviews all submitted representations. If an objection is found correct, the answer key is revised accordingly for all candidates not just the one who raised it. However, JKSSB has clarified that no individual candidate will be notified about whether their specific objection was accepted or rejected. The final answer key, incorporating any approved corrections, is released subsequently and forms the basis for result preparation.

What Is the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Final Answer Key?

The Final Answer Key is the definitive, officially approved set of correct answers for the RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director examination. It is published after the provisional answer key challenge window closes and all valid objections raised by candidates have been carefully reviewed by subject matter experts appointed by RPSC.

The final answer key carries absolute authority it is the version used to calculate the official marks of each candidate. Unlike the provisional answer key, no further objections can be raised against the final answer key. If any question was found to be incorrect, ambiguous, or contested through valid objections, RPSC may either revise the answer, award marks to all candidates who appeared for that question, or delete it entirely and all such changes will be reflected in the final answer key.

RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer Exam Paper Structure

This section explains the two-paper pattern of the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director written examination to help candidates understand the scope of each answer key PDF.

The RPSC Analyst-cum-Programmer examination consists of two papers, each carrying 100 marks and a duration of 2 hours. Together, both papers carry a combined total of 200 marks. Below is a summary of the subject coverage for each paper:

Paper Subject Areas Covered Total Marks Duration
Paper I Reasoning, Numerical Analysis, General Knowledge, Current Affairs 100 Marks 2 Hours
Paper II System Analysis & Design, Software Engineering, Software Project Management, Databases, Computer Networks 100 Marks 2 Hours

The minimum qualifying mark for the written examination is 40% in aggregate for General category candidates, and 36% for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. RPSC may additionally award up to 3 grace marks as per commission rules.

How to Download RPSC Final Answer Key 2026 for Analyst-cum-Programmer

Candidates can easily download both Paper I and Paper II final answer key PDFs from the RPSC official website by following the step-by-step process outlined below.

Step 1: Visit the official website of Rajasthan Public Service Commission at rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in.

Step 2: On the homepage, navigate to the "Answer Keys" section, which is available in the main menu or under the Quick Links area.

Step 3: On the Answer Keys page, look for the listing for "Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) - 2024."

Step 4: You will find separate download links for Paper I Answer Key and Paper II Answer Key.

Step 5: Click on the relevant link to open the answer key PDF in your browser.

Step 6: Download and save the PDF on your device.

Step 7: Cross-check your responses against the final answer key to estimate your marks in the examination.

Difference Between Provisional and Final Answer Key

Understanding the distinction between the provisional and final answer key helps candidates interpret the significance of this release.

RPSC follows a two-stage answer key process for all major examinations. First, a provisional answer key is published shortly after the examination, giving candidates an opportunity to raise objections against any answer they believe is incorrect by paying the prescribed objection fee. Once all objections are received and reviewed by an expert committee, RPSC publishes the final answer key. The final answer key incorporates all validated corrections, if any.

Stage Purpose Can Candidates Object?
Provisional Answer Key Initial set of answers for review Yes, within the objection window
Final Answer Key Verified correct answers for result computation No - final and binding

The score calculated using the final answer key will be the official score considered for merit list preparation.

What Happens After the RPSC Final Answer Key Is Released?

Once the final answer key for the Analyst-cum-Programmer/Deputy Director exam is out, RPSC moves forward with the result and merit list preparation process. Candidates should be aware of the following next steps:

RPSC will evaluate all answer sheets using the final answer key. Based on this evaluation, the commission computes the marks scored by each candidate. A result preamble along with the cutoff marks for both the Main List and Reserve List will be published and notably, RPSC has already published the Result Preamble and Cutoff Marks (Main List) and (Reserve List) for the Analyst-cum-Programmer (Deputy Director) 2024 examination on 22 June 2026 on the official website.

Candidates who qualify the written examination will be called for the next stages of selection, which typically include document verification and/or a personality test (interview), as per the selection process defined by RPSC for this post.

Keep checking rpsc.rajasthan.gov.in regularly for updates on the merit list, final result, and further recruitment notifications.

PSSSB Excise Inspector Exam Pattern and Marking Scheme 2026

Understanding the marking scheme is essential for candidates to accurately calculate their expected scores using the final answer key. The PSSSB Excise Inspector written examination 2026 was divided into two parts.

The exam consisted of two parts Part A (Punjabi Language) which was qualifying in nature, and Part B which carried marks counted towards the merit list. A negative marking rule applied in Part B only.

Marking Scheme Table:

Section Details
Part A Punjabi Language (Qualifying in Nature)
Qualifying Marks in Part A Minimum 50% marks required to qualify
Marking in Part A No negative marking
Part B Main Subjects (Counted for Merit)
Marks for Correct Answer (Part B) +1 Mark
Negative Marking for Wrong Answer (Part B) -0.25 Marks (deducted per wrong answer)
Unattempted Questions 0 Marks

How to Calculate Your Expected Score:

Candidates can use the formula below to estimate their total expected marks from Part B:

Expected Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

Candidates who have not qualified in Part A (below 50%) will be marked "NQ" (Not Qualified) in the result and will not be considered for merit, regardless of their Part B score.

PSSSB Excise Inspector 2026 - Selection Process

Candidates who qualify the written examination will proceed through the remaining stages of the selection process as prescribed by PSSSB for the 197 Excise and Taxation Inspector posts.

The selection process for PSSSB Excise Inspector 2026 consists of three stages:

Stage 1 - Written Examination: OMR-based objective test held on 31 May 2026 comprising Part A (Punjabi Language) and Part B (Main Subjects). Part A is qualifying; Part B marks are used for merit.

Stage 2 - Typing Test / Computer Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify in the written examination will be called for the Typing Test or Computer Proficiency Test, as applicable to the post requirement.

Stage 3 - Document Verification (DV): Candidates who clear both earlier stages will be required to produce all original documents for verification of eligibility, category, and educational qualifications.

Only candidates who successfully complete all three stages are considered for final appointment to Excise and Taxation Inspector posts in Punjab.

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

How to Download JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse Answer Key 2026 PDF

The JKSSB Provisional Answer Key for Junior Staff Nurse and Junior Male Nurse is available in PDF format on the official website. Candidates must identify their correct paper series before matching answers, as the correct options differ across Series A, B, C, and D. Follow the simple steps below to access and download the answer key.

  1. Visit the official JKSSB website at jkssb.nic.in
  2. Navigate to the "Examinations" section on the homepage
  3. Click on the "Answer Key" link from the dropdown or navigation menu
  4. Locate the link for "Provisional Answer Key - Junior Staff Nurse / Junior Male Nurse 2026"
  5. The PDF file will open; it contains answers for all four series (A, B, C, D)
  6. Identify the series printed on your OMR sheet or question booklet
  7. Match your responses with the correct answers listed under your specific series
  8. Download and save the PDF for future reference and objection purposes

Direct PDF Link: JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse Provisional Answer Key 2026

How to Check Your Answers Correctly - Series-Wise Guide

The JKSSB OMR-based examination for Junior Staff Nurse and Junior Male Nurse was conducted using four different question paper series A, B, C, and D. This is a standard practice to prevent malpractice, but it means that candidates must strictly use only their own series when cross-checking answers, as the same question number may have a different correct answer in different series.

  • Check your admit card or OMR sheet to identify which series (A, B, C, or D) you were allotted
  • Open the provisional answer key PDF from jkssb.nic.in
  • Refer only to the column corresponding to your paper series
  • Do not compare answers with candidates who had a different series
  • Note down all questions where your response does not match the official answer

How to Calculate Your Expected Score

After downloading the provisional answer key, candidates can calculate their estimated marks based on the marking scheme applicable to the JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse written examination. Understanding the scoring pattern helps candidates gauge their performance and set expectations before the final result.

  • Correct Answer: Add +1 mark for every correct response
  • Wrong Answer: Deduct ¼ mark (0.25 marks) for every incorrect response
  • Unattempted Questions: No marks are added or deducted for questions left blank

Use this formula to calculate your estimated total:

Estimated Score = (Number of Correct Answers × 1) - (Number of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

How to Raise Objections Against JKSSB Provisional Answer Key 2026

If candidates believe any answer in the provisional answer key is incorrect, JKSSB provides a formal objection mechanism. Objections must be submitted offline only online submissions are not accepted. The objection window is open for 3 working days from the date of answer key release. Candidates must act promptly as this window is short.

Follow the steps below to raise a valid objection:

  1. Download the Objection Format (Annexure B) from jkssb.nic.in
  2. Fill in your personal and exam details candidate name, application number, roll number, exam centre division, and the specific question number and series being challenged
  3. State the objection clearly and attach hard-copy documentary proof or reference material supporting your claim
  4. Prepare a Demand Draft of ₹200 per question in favour of the Accounts Officer, J&K Services Selection Board
  5. Submit the completed objection form, supporting evidence, and demand draft in person at the JKSSB office in either:
    • Jammu Office, or Srinagar Office
  6. Ensure submission is made within the 3-working-day window from the answer key release date

What Happens After the Objection Period?

Once the objection window closes, JKSSB subject experts review all valid challenges received from candidates. Based on this review, the Board may revise certain answers or retain them as originally published. The final outcome of this process is the Final Answer Key, which forms the basis for result preparation.

  • All valid objections with documentary support are reviewed by JKSSB experts
  • If an objection is found valid, the answer for that question may be revised or the question may be cancelled
  • The Final Answer Key is published after the review process is complete
  • The JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse result / merit list is prepared strictly based on the Final Answer Key
  • If a question is cancelled, marks are awarded to all candidates regardless of their response

About JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse / Junior Male Nurse Recruitment 2026

The JKSSB Junior Staff Nurse and Junior Male Nurse recruitment is being conducted under Notification No. 07 of 2025 issued by the Health and Medical Education Department of Jammu and Kashmir. The posts fall under Item Numbers 99 to 108 within the notification. The written examination was held on 28 June 2026 in OMR-based format. Candidates who qualify through the written exam and final selection process will be posted across various healthcare institutions in Jammu and Kashmir.

Role Snapshot
About Nymbus

Nymbus is a cloud-native core banking platform and managed services provider serving community banks and credit unions. We deliver the technology infrastructure, operational services, and digital experience capabilities our clients need to compete and grow. Our managed services model means we are not just a software vendor; we are embedded in the day-to-day operations of our clients' institutions, accountable for outcomes, not just uptime.

Role Purpose

The SVP of Banking Operations leads the full managed services delivery function at Nymbus, spanning contact center operations, digital banking support, fraud operations, onboarding, and lending support. This leader is accountable for current-state operational excellence that keeps clients and SLAs intact while simultaneously redesigning the operating model from the ground up using AI-first principles, agentic automation, and scalable architecture.

This is a rare role. It sits at the intersection of enterprise-grade operational accountability and a genuine mandate to build something new. The right candidate will not optimize the current model. They will hold it loosely, keep it running, and replace it with something better.

Why This Role, Why Now

Nymbus is in active transformation. We are rebuilding how managed services delivers client outcomes with agentic automation and scalable process architecture as the baseline, not as an enhancement layer. The SVP of Banking Operations inherits strong day-to-day leaders and a capable team. The job is to set the strategic direction, remove the ceiling on what that team can accomplish, and build the model that serves our next 100 clients as efficiently as our first.

Banking Operations is also a revenue-generating function. This leader will work alongside sales, partnerships, and product to identify expansion opportunities within the managed services book, support client retention and upsell conversations, and build the commercial case for new service capabilities as the operating model matures.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Own and oversee end-to-end service delivery across all managed services operational domains, including contact center, digital banking support, fraud operations, onboarding, and lending support
  • Hold SLA accountability; ensure client commitments are met consistently and predictably across the book of business
  • Lead and develop two established operational leaders and their teams; set performance expectations and optimize the layer of management beneath them
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for operational client issues requiring executive-level engagement

AI-First Operating Model Design

  • Lead the redesign of the Banking Operations model with agentic AI, automation, and scalability as first principles, not as additions to existing workflows
  • Partner with product, engineering, and the Applied AI Practice to identify, prioritize, and implement automation opportunities across the service delivery stack
  • Measure and report on efficiency gains, capacity freed, and quality improvements resulting from AI adoption
  • Build and maintain a clear view of where human judgment is required and where it is not; design accordingly

Revenue and Client Partnership

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key managed services clients, operating as a trusted advisor in a regulated industry context
  • Partner with sales, partnerships, and client success to support upsells, contract renewals, and new client introductions
  • Identify and develop new managed services revenue opportunities, including pricing optimization, service packaging, and capability expansion
  • Represent operations in external client conversations about service evolution, roadmap, and AI-enabled capability development
  • Ensure clients experience the tangible, visible impact of operational and AI investment in their outcomes

Organizational and Talent Development

  • Hire, develop, and retain operational leaders who can execute in a transformation environment while keeping current service commitments intact
  • Build a team culture of accountability, curiosity, and continuous improvement
  • Create the internal capability to run today's model while designing and migrating to tomorrow's simultaneously

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for a great operations manager in the traditional sense. We are looking for a builder who happens to be an excellent operator. The right person for this role sees AI not as a tool on top of operations but as the operating model itself.

AI-First Mindset

Has led or is deeply experienced with AI and automation adoption in an operational context. Does not treat AI as an enhancement layer. Knows how to design processes from scratch with agentic AI built in. Has an informed view of where automation creates risk in a regulated environment and how to manage it.

Regulated Industry Experience

Understands the constraints of operating in a regulated environment: compliance requirements, audit readiness, and what cannot be automated without oversight. Fintech, banking, credit union, or adjacent regulated services experience strongly preferred. Does not need to be a compliance expert; needs to know where the lines are.

Transformation Leadership

Has led a team through a meaningful operational redesign at speed. Has managed the complexity of maintaining current client commitments while building toward a fundamentally different model. Has made hard calls about what to automate, what to sunset, and what to protect.

Commercial and Client Orientation

Treats operations as a client relationship and a growth lever, not just a cost center. Has experience in client-facing operational roles or in environments where service delivery is the product. Comfortable in commercial conversations about pricing, service packaging, and capability expansion.

Builder Mentality

Energized by ambiguity and the absence of a playbook. Not looking to manage a stable operation; looking to transform one. Has designed processes, teams, and systems from scratch. Is not waiting for perfect information to move.

The Role We Need

PadSplit is entering a stage where creative is becoming a strategic growth lever, not just a production function. You'll have the opportunity to influence everything from national marketing campaigns and social content to the way members, hosts, and partners experience the PadSplit brand every day.


The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for a creative leader who enjoys building as much as leading. This is a true player-coach role for someone who loves developing people, embraces AI and modern creative tools, and can balance exceptional brand storytelling with performance marketing that delivers measurable results. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable presenting creative strategy to executives, coaching designers through feedback, and rolling up their sleeves to help solve a creative challenge when needed.



Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day


  • Lead Creative Vision: Set and evolve PadSplit's creative direction across every customer touchpoint while ensuring a consistent, trusted brand experience.




  • Coach The Team: Lead, mentor, and develop designers, contractors, and agency partners while remaining hands-on in key creative initiatives.




  • Drive Campaigns: Partner with Marketing to create high-performing creative across paid, organic, lifecycle, email, social, and emerging channels.




  • Build Operations: Establish scalable creative workflows, production systems, quality standards, and resource management that enable speed without sacrificing quality.




  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Growth, Legal, and Operations to ensure creative is embedded early in major initiatives.




  • Strengthen Brand: Own PadSplit's visual identity, creative standards, messaging consistency, and overall brand reputation across every channel.




  • Leverage Customer Insights: Translate research, customer feedback, and performance data into stronger creative strategies and messaging.




  • Measure Performance: Use creative performance metrics, experimentation, and AI-powered workflows to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and creative output.






Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful


  • Creative Leadership: 8+ years leading brand, marketing, or creative organizations with at least 3 years managing creative teams.




  • Player-Coach Style: Comfortable both leading others and personally contributing to creative strategy, reviews, and execution when needed.




  • Performance Mindset: Experience creating creative that not only looks exceptional but improves acquisition, conversion, and customer engagement.




  • Operational Excellence: Experience building scalable creative operations using systems, vendors, contractors, and repeatable processes.




  • AI Fluency: Comfortable incorporating AI tools into creative workflows to improve speed, quality, and efficiency while maintaining authenticity.




  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to connect creative decisions to business objectives, customer insights, and measurable outcomes.




  • Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to build strong partnerships across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Executive Leadership.




  • Mission Alignment: Excited by using creative storytelling to build trust and advance PadSplit's mission of expanding affordable housing.






Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager

  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes

  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our President for one (1) hour

  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our CEO for one (1) hour

  • If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for two (2) hours

  • The panel interview will require a candidate to work on a creative assessment where you will showcase your brand and design skills to the panel for discussion. 

  • If warranted, then we move to offer!

  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity

  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans

  • Company provided life insurance policy

  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits

  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays

  • 401(k) plan 

  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents

  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

About Us

Bezos.ai is a Fulfilment-as-a-Service (FaaS) platform. Online sellers connect their sales channels (Amazon, eBay, Shopify) and we orchestrate the rest: routing orders to a global network of warehouse and carrier partners, tracking every parcel to the customer's door, and giving sellers one clean view of their entire supply chain. We are a small, fast-moving, AI-native team that is almost doubling our business in 2026. Operations is the engine room, and this is where you learn how a real logistics platform runs: fast, with real ownership from day one.

Your Mission

Be the dependable engine of the ops team. You'll keep orders flowing - spotting and resolving the ones that get stuck or go missing - answer seller and operational queries, run our operational checks, and help build the AI skills and automations that take the repetitive work off everyone's plate. You'll learn the whole order journey end-to-end and, within months, start figuring things out on your own.

Core Pillars

  • Keep the flow clean: Run the daily cross-system checks; spot orders that are missing, stuck or mismatched, and resolve or escalate them
  • Support sellers & partners: Answer operational tickets, run checkers, and create/send invoices accurately and on time
  • Learn to build: Use Claude to build skills and automations that remove repetitive work, starting with the recruitment exercise and growing from there
  • Improve as you go: Drive incremental improvements to the tools and processes you touch every day

What You'll Achieve In Your First 90 Days

  • Run the daily cross-system reconciliation reliably and clear order exceptions in your queue
  • Answer operational tickets within SLA and run the Bezos checkers independently
  • Build your first working Claude skill or small automation that saves the team time
  • Deliver clean, on-time work on a team project and start figuring out open-ended tasks with less hand-holding

Requirements

What we're looking for (non-negotiables)

  • Numerate & analytical. A degree (or clearly demonstrated equivalent) in a quantitative discipline, eg engineering, maths, physics, CS, or a heavily numerate economics / finance / quant-social-science track. Comfortable with raw data and spreadsheets
  • AI-native: can build, not just chat. You use Claude/AI in your daily work and can build a simple, working Claude skill. You don't need a portfolio of production agents yet, but you must demonstrate building one in the recruitment exercise. (Having already built skills/agents is a strong plus.)
  • Reliable & coachable. Delivers what's asked, on time, with clean work; asks questions when stuck rather than guessing; takes feedback well
  • Picks things up fast. Learns new tools and processes quickly and gets productive without a long ramp
  • Energised by startups. Excited by ambiguity, pace and ownership, wants a wide remit, not a narrow one
  • Clear communicator. Writes clearly, presents simple findings, and flags problems early

Nice-to-haves

  • Internships or part-time work in consulting, banking, operations, analytics, consulting, e-commerce or a startup
  • Light coding (Python / SQL) or no-code tooling (Make, Zapier, Retool, Airtable)
  • Having already built a Claude skill, agent or automation of your own

  • Work in a genuinely AI-native team. Build with Claude, Retool and Make daily, with real budget and the freedom to automate your own job
  • The ability to shape your role in a fast-growing, exciting company at the forefront of the future of e-commerce
  • A workplace that's entrepreneurial, fast-paced, outcome-focused and disciplined, but also highly collaborative, team-oriented and fun
  • Significant opportunity for growth and personal development, and the chance to have a real impact
  • The team is fully remote, but meets in person a couple of times a month
  • 25 holidays + 8 bank holidays
  • Mental health support through Spill, and a free Headspace subscription
